stem.text: Why are spleen cells fused with myeloma cells during monoclonal antibody production?

A.text: so that the antibodies become specific for the necessary antigen

B.text: so that the resulting hybridoma cells can reproduce indefinitely

C.text: to allow antibodies that are **not** specific for the required antigen to be removed

D.text: to increase the rate of production of antibodies produced by the hybridoma cells
